label: binary BBB permeability (1=BBB-permeant, 0=BBB-non-permeant, per Martins et al.)

global_split.description: Scaffold-level split_group 9, per ADR-009. Touched once, here.

thresholds.derivation: 10th/90th percentile of the TRAINING population's own self-similarity/self-distance, excluding each compound's guaranteed match to itself.

external_validation.reason: No independent second-source BBB dataset identified in this pass, same situation as every other new endpoint in this pipeline.

limitations: BBB permeability here is a binary passive/measured brain-plasma partitioning call, not CNS efficacy or exposure at a therapeutic dose -- 'BBB-permeant' does not mean 'clinically active in the CNS.' See scientific-foundation.md's BBB-lipophilicity section: LogP correlates with passive permeability but is neither necessary nor sufficient (active transport, TPSA/HBD are often better predictors).
Class imbalance (~76% BBB-permeant in the raw source) means ROC-AUC/balanced accuracy should be read alongside precision/recall/MCC, not alone.
Classical models only in this pass; no GNN benchmark (small-data regime, no existing GNN infrastructure in this repository).
No external validation performed in this pass.
This model is not integrated into the live /predict API -- offline evaluation only.
